summary: State-emporium shopping under one roof, handicrafts and handlooms from across India, the campus's answer to souvenir hunting.
description:
Ekta Mall runs the unity theme through retail: floors of emporium-style outlets representing states' handicrafts and handloom traditions, textiles, brass, woodwork, paintings, the familiar government-emporium canon, collected beside the statue so visitors can shop the country in an hour. Prices are fixed-tag emporium level: fair for verified craft, no bargaining theatre.

As malls go it is small and as craft collections go it is broad-but-shallow; its real function is convenience. If your itinerary already crosses serious craft sources (or the Artist Village in Dang for local work), spend there: otherwise this is the dependable one-stop for gifts before the train.
